page_content: Applicant must record the document at the Office of the County Recorder.  3. A certified copy of the recorded Statement of Eligibility must be returned to the Zoning Administrator. All of the information and exhibits submitted in connection with the application are retained as part of the permanent public record, which is subject to the Public Records Act. 4. The Zoning Administrator may issue a Notice of Suspension of Eligibility for a lot if it is determined that a building on a Preservation Lot has been altered or demolished in violation of Planning Code. Step 2: Certificate of Transfer The Certificate of Transfer is the second step in the process to transfer the previously determined amount of TDR units from the Transfer Lot to another party (transferee).
